service: appointment-service
frameworkVersion: '4'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ${env:AWS_REGION, 'us-east-2'}
  stage: ${env:STAGE, 'dev'}
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:GetItem
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:*:table/${self:custom.ddbTable}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:*:table/${self:custom.ddbTable}/index/*
        - Effect: Allow
          Action: sns:Publish
          Resource: "*"
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sqs:SendMessage
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
          Resource: "*"
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - events:PutEvents
          Resource: "*"

  environment:
    DDB_TABLE: ${self:custom.ddbTable}
    SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref Topic
    SQS_PE_URL: !Ref QueuePE
    SQS_CL_URL: !Ref QueueCL
    COMPLETION_SQS_URL: !Ref CompletionQueue
    EVENT_BUS_NAME: ${self:custom.eventBusName}

plugins:
  - serverless-offline
  - serverless-dotenv-plugin

package:
  individually: true

custom:
  ddbTable: ${env:DDB_TABLE_NAME, 'Appointments'}
  eventBusName: ${env:EVENT_BUS_NAME, 'appointment-bus'}
  esbuild:
    bundle: true
    minify: true
    target: 'node20'
    platform: 'node'
    sourcemap: true
    exclude: ['@aws-sdk/*']

functions:
  appointment:
    handler: src/infrastructure/api/appointment.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /appointments
          method: post
      - httpApi:
          path: /appointments/{insuredId}
          method: get
      - httpApi:
          path: /openapi.json
          method: get
      - sqs:
          arn: { 'Fn::GetAtt': [ CompletionQueue, Arn ] }

  appointment_pe:
    handler: src/infrastructure/api/appointment_pe.handler
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: { 'Fn::GetAtt': [ QueuePE, Arn ] }

  appointment_cl:
    handler: src/infrastructure/api/appointment_cl.handler
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: { 'Fn::GetAtt': [ QueueCL, Arn ] }

resources:
  Resources:
    AppointmentsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:custom.ddbTable}
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: insuredId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: appointmentId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: insuredId
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: appointmentId
            KeyType: RANGE
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: appointmentIdIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: appointmentId
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL

    Topic:
      Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
      Properties:
        TopicName: appointment-topic

    QueuePE:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: SQS_PE

    QueueCL:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: SQS_CL

    QueuePolicyPE:
      Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
      Properties:
        Queues:
          - !Ref QueuePE
        PolicyDocument:
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal: "*"
              Action: "SQS:SendMessage"
              Resource: !GetAtt QueuePE.Arn
              Condition:
                ArnEquals:
                  aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt Topic.Arn

    QueuePolicyCL:
      Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
      Properties:
        Queues:
          - !Ref QueueCL
        PolicyDocument:
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal: "*"
              Action: "SQS:SendMessage"
              Resource: !GetAtt QueueCL.Arn
              Condition:
                ArnEquals:
                  aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt Topic.Arn

    TopicSubscriptionPE:
      Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
      Properties:
        TopicArn: { Ref: Topic }
        Protocol: sqs
        Endpoint: { 'Fn::GetAtt': [ QueuePE, Arn ] }
        FilterPolicy:
          countryISO:
            - PE

    TopicSubscriptionCL:
      Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
      Properties:
        TopicArn: { Ref: Topic }
        Protocol: sqs
        Endpoint: { 'Fn::GetAtt': [ QueueCL, Arn ] }
        FilterPolicy:
          countryISO:
            - CL

    CompletionQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: appointment-completed

    EventBus:
      Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
      Properties:
        Name: ${self:custom.eventBusName}

    EventRuleToCompletionQueue:
      Type: AWS::Events::Rule
      Properties:
        EventBusName: ${self:custom.eventBusName}
        EventPattern:
          source:
            - "appointment.processor"
          detail-type:
            - "AppointmentProcessed"
        Targets:
          - Arn: { 'Fn::GetAtt': [ CompletionQueue, Arn ] }
            Id: "CompletionQueueTarget"

  Outputs:
    SnsTopicArn:
      Value: !Ref Topic
    SqsPEUrl:
      Value: !Ref QueuePE
    SqsCLUrl:
      Value: !Ref QueueCL
    CompletionSqsUrl:
      Value: !Ref CompletionQueue
